verificationChecks.name: Discrepancy Resolution (Commons Lang)
verificationChecks.details: Root cause proven to be manual hardcoded 4-commit filter in scratch/evaluate_commons_lang_candidates.js vs. automated 5-commit scan. Sensitivity analysis confirms identical scientific ranking.

caveatsAndKnownLimitations: OCCP's typed-path signal exhibits extreme sparsity on loosely coupled libraries (Commons Lang) and multi-module architectures (Shopizer), falling back past typed paths in >78% of decisions.
CSF does not achieve statistically significant superiority over the V4 Historical Co-Change Reranker (p = 0.1691) across K = 25 commits, though it yields the highest numerical MAP, P@5, and F1@5.
